_comment: Gzip limits (level 9) for the production build, enforced by scripts/check-budgets.mjs. Measured 21 Nov 2026 on one laptop (see docs/performance.md) after moving the app shell off the design barrel: first-load JS 109.4 kB (React DOM 62 + React Router 31 + React 3 are 96 of it), first-load CSS 7.1 kB, largest lazy chunk 34.8 kB (Call), largest CSS file 5.5 kB, no fonts. Before: first-load JS 114.8 kB, first-load CSS 10.5 kB. The first-load JS limit is the product target (110 kB), not measured plus headroom, so that the barrel mistake (114.8 kB) cannot come back unnoticed; the others are measured plus about 8 percent. Fonts, source maps, extra pages and zod are not budgeted: they are not allowed at all. Raising a limit is a decision: say why in the commit.
